HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   B. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   D. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

4. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat National Security as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.

5. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   D. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

7. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   B. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   C. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.
   B. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.
   D. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

11. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.
   B. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   C. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Global diversity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The 2nd Generation of Industrial revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Conflict, Transformation and Peace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Digital divide and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
